{{Top|leg}}
'''Optical processors''' were capable of projecting data onto clear [[Plastex/Legends|plastex]] sheets. They were commonly used to display tactical and strategic data. The ''[[FarStar]]''{{'s}} tactics room had plastex sheets with optical processors installed.
